name: Enchanté Poached Blue Maine Lobster & Wild Turbot with Champagne Velouté
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement
whyItWorks: Three-Michelin-starred French culinary technique: butter-poached Maine lobster and flaky wild turbot have zero insoluble fiber and melt on the fork.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Inform the Enchanté maître d' of your strict zero-citrus requirement (Chef Lallement uses lemon/citrus acidity as a signature motif and the kitchen will custom-poach your lobster and turbot in pure butter/shallot-free stock).
watchOuts: Signature Lallement sauces often use lemon/citrus acidity unless requested citrus-free
